name: Flow 55
notes: Water surface, current, drifted snow: the sand spectrum put through a domain warp, which bends straight crests into flow lines. A stationary spectrum has no large-scale organisation by construction; the warp is the one way to give it some. TONAL dual-gate: the mask is the tone-mapped field itself, so the stroke carries the texture as graded alpha and the level number is the damage/modulation DEPTH. Rides the SHALLOW RIGID train (dual scatter 0.2, spacing 0.28, n=3) because the warp makes its curves PHASE structure, and a deep train averages independent windows and blends curves away. Measured both ways on this family: three-quarters more delivered contrast on the rigid train at equal ripple (docs/spectral-atlas.md §4). tonal.gain 1.7 is the shallower train's compensation. Tip from tips/flow.spec.json; audited by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs.
